subject: Observability onboarding: stakeholder cascade & pre-kickoff checklist
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Sally Tan <sally.tan@clouddock.com>, ops@clouddock.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-06-30T16:12:00Z
Subject: Observability onboarding: stakeholder cascade & pre-kickoff checklist

Hi Sally + CloudDock ops team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for your inference stack visibility. Before our kickoff I want to run a short "stakeholder cascade" so everyone knows who owns what across dashboards, tracing, alerts, and runbooks. Goal: make the first two weeks of implementation low-friction and get a small set of production runbooks live by week 4.

Proposed agenda for the kickoff (30 min):
- Quick intros and success criteria (5m)
- Dashboard runway: latency, error rate, model drift signals (7m)
- Trace hook matrix: where to instrument (model entry, batching layer, cache misses) (7m)
- Alert routing & escalation ladder (5m)
- Runbook ownership and next steps (6m)

Prework for CloudDock (please upload to the Drive link below prior to the meeting):
- Representative traffic sample (1 hour peak window)
- List of customer-facing SLOs and current error budget policy
- Any existing tracing headers or sampling configs

Internal owners I’m proposing:
- Dashboards: Marissa Cole (CS Ops)
- Tracing hooks & sampling: Ben Carter (Infra)
- Alert routing & escalation: Laura Bennett (SRE partner)
- Runbook template & collate: Irene Choi (CS Manager)

Attachments: onboarding-runbook-template.md, onboarding-prework-checklist.pdf (links included in Drive).

Please confirm a preferred kickoff time tomorrow or Thursday. I’ll schedule once we have a slot.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

---
Note: Drive: https://drive.redwood/company/CloudDock/obs-prework

Date: 2025-06-30T19:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Observability onboarding: stakeholder cascade & pre-kickoff checklist

Thanks Irene — this looks great.

We can do a 30-minute kickoff on 2025-07-03 at 21:00 UTC (14:00 PT) — that works for our on-call and platform leads. I’ve added ops@clouddock.com so the infra team sees the prework request.

A couple quick notes from our side:
- Priority metrics: per-model 95th/99th latency, end-to-end error rate for inference calls, and cache miss rate.
- We currently sample traces at 0.5% globally; we'd like guidance on adaptive sampling for spikes.
- On compliance: our procurement team will request SOC2 evidence and retention policy; I’ll upload a list of questions to the Drive folder.

Attaching our internal contact list (stub). I’ll ask procurement to open the HubSpot ticket for formal PO steps.

Best,
Sally Tan
Platform Engineering Manager
CloudDock
